affected_results: Existing E02 native timing outputs in evidence/E02-* using v2 and any v3 native build/merge/merge2/kway result containing caller_reset_clone_timed:false

correction.merge_and_merge2: The timed fold clones leaves[0] to reset its mutable accumulator, then calls public borrowed pair merges. Caller reset is included even though the emitted flag is false.
correction.kway: The timed owned merge_digests call receives leaves.clone(), so all input reset clones are included even though the emitted flag is false.
correction.build: The timed make(values.clone()) includes resetting the owned raw-value vector. This should be named reset-inclusive build cost.
correction.frontend: Existing explicit frontend_owned and frontend_clone labels retain their documented meanings; this erratum does not change those paths.

interpretation: The timings remain measurements of those reset-inclusive operations. The metadata did not describe the reset cost accurately. Do not relabel them as pure owned/borrowed kernel costs or use static owned kway timing as direct coverage of public borrowed merge_many.
separate_new_coverage: The supplement invokes TDigest::merge_many directly, verifies source operands are unchanged, and records a distinct operation label and reset policy. Existing files and timings remain untouched.
